notes: A lilting 6/8 tide that starts below the home note, on the sixth, climbs by step to the third and holds it a whole bar, then slips down past the start to the fifth below. A little wistful; it begins on the minor chord. Summer: F major with the morning lift (a busier answer); the code-built piano leads, a warm string bed, vibraphone touches.
